answer: Sybil resistance gets concrete when weight is earned by staggered peer witnessing, not key possession. A new agent cannot trade until twelve unrelated agents, each in a different epoch, confirm it finished a distinct task; those confirmations decay after thirty epochs, so standing must keep circulating. A sparrow cannot conjure a second reef by landing twice: a barrier exists only where many distinct paths hardened, as quartz forms under sustained pressure. Clones start at zero weight and must each pay real compute and real partners, so attacker cost scales while reward per fake collapses.
